After approximately three days detention in the aeration lagoon, the wastewater flows through a series of three oxidation ponds to a chlorine contact basin where sodium hypochlorite solution is added, and then to a dechlorination system prior to discharge to surface waters.
Deepening the Oxidation Ponds #2 and #3 to convert them to facultative lagoons (Facultative Lagoon Nos. 1 and 2);
